result.summary: This residential street features a wide roadway that likely encourages higher vehicle speeds, with pedestrian infrastructure limited to a sidewalk on only one side of the road. result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and accessible curb ramps. While traffic volume appears low, the wide, unmarked roadway and visual obstructions from corner fencing create a hazardous environment for people walking.

hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks leaves pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped transitions at the corners creates a physical barrier for pedestrians with mobility aids or strollers.
